findings.quote: アプリケーションが不要になったオブジェクトでも
findings.reason: The subject marker が makes the application the entity that became unnecessary; the English refers to objects the application no longer needs. The surrounding context makes the intended meaning recoverable, but the phrasing is grammatically misleading.
findings.fix: アプリケーションにとって不要になったオブジェクトでも

checks_actually_done: Read both complete target prose bodies first for naturalness, terminology, Chinese simplified script/punctuation, Japanese polite register, referents, flow and unintended language mixing.

Compared complete English source paragraph by paragraph, including title, description, all tables, headings, caveats and production guidance. All 48 blank-line-separated body blocks, 9 headings and 26 table rows are represented in each language.

Compared JDK 28 Targeted/EA versus GA, JDK 27 defaults, historical introduction/product/deprecation/removal milestones, distributor/platform/support caveats, generation mode versus JVM-wide collector defaults, obsolete/remove distinctions, and removed-option observations.

Compared all quantities, dates, version/build strings, memory payload versus overhead, 12 execution configurations, actual-execution versus official-source-only scope, archived-security-version limitation and nonbenchmark/noncausality qualifications.

Programmatically confirmed all fenced code blocks and ordered inline-code tokens are byte-identical to source in each target; all ordered prose link destinations match source. Diagram paths intentionally use local SVG filenames.

Read localized diagram JSON and extracted SVG title/description/text; compared five steps and loop to source diagram and Java allocation/reference/checksum sequence. Parsed both JSON and SVG XML successfully; checked displayed SVG strings exactly match localized diagram JSON.
